control_reference.control_name: Automated premium-to-GL posting is complete and accurate

input_context.scope_note: Premium amounts calculated in the policy administration system post to the general ledger completely and accurately, so that recorded premium revenue is supported by an independent recalculation with no unexplained variance.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: System interfaces reconcile on control totals

input_context.scope_note: Data transmitted across in-scope system interfaces is reconciled on record counts and control totals between the sending and receiving systems, so that no financially-significant records are lost, duplicated, or altered in transit.

threshold_comparison.test_name: No unreconciled records across in-scope interfaces.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

input_context.scope_note: All required sub-certifiers complete and sign their quarterly sub-certifications on time, providing the documented basis on which the CEO and CFO rely to make the §302 disclosure certification.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: ICFR control matrix is complete and key controls are tested

input_context.scope_note: The ICFR control matrix is complete with a named owner for every key control, all key controls are tested within the assessment cycle, and identified deficiencies are remediated, supporting management's §404 assessment of internal control over financial reporting.

threshold_comparison.test_name: Every key control has a named owner.
All key controls tested this cycle.

event_log.description: Run warning (2 of 3 assertions not passing)

control_runs.notes: Remediate before relying on dependent artifacts.

corrective_actions: Open a SOX deficiency issue for controls without an owner.
Track untested controls and unremediated deficiencies to completion before §404 assessment sign-off.

control_reference.control_name: Access provisioning is approved before grant

input_context.scope_note: Every grant of access to a financially-significant application is authorized by an appropriate approver before the access is provisioned, so that only properly authorized users can transact.

threshold_comparison.test_name: No in-scope grants without a prior approval.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

input_context.scope_note: On a quarterly basis, application owners review and formally recertify all user access to financially-significant systems so that access remains commensurate with current job responsibilities.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: Privileged access is logged and independently reviewed

input_context.scope_note: All privileged accounts on financially-significant systems are inventoried, their actions are captured in the SIEM, and each account is independently reviewed each quarter so that elevated access cannot be misused without detection.

threshold_comparison.test_name: All privileged actions captured in the SIEM.

event_log.description: Run failed (2 of 3 assertions not passing)

control_runs.notes: Remediate before relying on dependent artifacts.

remediation_workflow.root_cause: Observed 3 violates eq 0; Observed 83 violates gte 100
corrective_actions: Complete the missing reviews and remediate logging gaps before relying on the control.

control_reference.control_name: Segregation of duties enforced on financial roles

input_context.scope_note: Conflicting financial duties are prevented or mitigated by enforcing a segregation-of-duties ruleset across role assignments so that no single user can both initiate and conceal an erroneous or fraudulent transaction.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

input_context.scope_note: Access for terminated personnel is revoked from financially-significant systems within the defined service-level agreement so that no former employee retains the ability to transact.

threshold_comparison.test_name: No active accounts for terminated staff.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: Changes are approved before promotion to production

input_context.scope_note: Every change promoted to a financially-significant production system is formally approved before deployment, so that only authorized, reviewed changes affect the financial reporting environment.

threshold_comparison.test_name: Every production change had a prior approval.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: Developers cannot approve or deploy their own changes

input_context.scope_note: No individual can both author and approve, or both author and deploy, a change to a financially-significant production system, enforcing segregation of duties across the change lifecycle.

threshold_comparison.test_name: No self-approved merges to protected branches.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

input_context.scope_note: Every emergency change to a financially-significant system is logged, retroactively approved, and subject to a post-implementation review, so that expedited changes remain governed even when normal pre-approval is bypassed.

threshold_comparison.test_name: Every emergency change had a post-implementation review.

event_log.description: Run warning (1 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_runs.notes: Remediate before relying on dependent artifacts.

corrective_actions: Chase outstanding retroactive approvals to closure.
Open a SOX deficiency issue if any emergency change lacks a post-implementation review.

control_reference.control_name: Financially-relevant batch jobs are monitored and failures resolved

input_context.scope_note: Financially-relevant batch jobs are monitored, their failures raise alerts, and every failure is resolved, so that financial data is processed completely and accurately on schedule.

threshold_comparison.test_name: No unresolved failures of financially-relevant jobs.
All job failures raise an alert.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: Backups succeed and restores are periodically tested

input_context.scope_note: Backups of financially-significant systems succeed on schedule and restores are periodically tested, so that financial data can be recovered intact in the event of loss or corruption.

threshold_comparison.test_name: A restore test was performed this cycle.

event_log.description: Run passed (0 of 2 assertions not passing)

control_reference.control_name: Financial records retention and legal holds are enforced

input_context.scope_note: In-scope financial records are retained under an enforced retention policy that meets the statutory minimum, legal holds are applied where required, and no records are prematurely deleted, satisfying the §802 records-retention requirements.

threshold_comparison.test_name: Retention policy applied to all in-scope repositories.
No premature deletions of in-scope records.
